entities.summary: Enguerrand de Monstrelet was a French chronicler who chronicled significant events of the late medieval period, providing valuable insights into the politics, society, and culture of 15th-century Europe. His chronicle, which covers the period from 1337 to 1467, offers a unique perspective on the Hundred Years' War, the rise of the Burgundian duchy, and the impact of the Black Death on European society. De Monstrelet's work not only reflected the major events of his time but also shaped the way historians understand the complexities of medieval politics and society.
